summary: Public interest litigation under Article 32 for enforceable right to sanitation in court premises; toilet facilities for men, women, transgender persons, and persons with disabilities mandated as part of dignity under Article 21; reference to Directive Principles (Articles 47, 48A); Transgender Persons Act, 2019 and Rules, 2020 requiring inclusive washroom infrastructure; Harmonised Guidelines & Standards for Universal Accessibility, 2021 cited; Supreme Court monitors compliance via iJuris portal; direction for uniform implementation across all High Courts and district judiciary.
legal_provisions_cited: Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 s.3
Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Rules, 2020 r.10
Harmonised Guidelines & Standards for Universal Accessibility in India, 2021
final_judgment: Directions issued for universal access to hygienic toilet facilities in all court premises; High Courts to ensure compliance and upload data on iJuris; status of implementation to be reported periodically; petition effectively allowed in spirit with continuing judicial oversight.
